sentences.en: There are none so deaf as those who won't hear.
sentences.zh: 最聋的是那些不愿听的人。

sentences.en: There were no schools for the deaf at that time.
sentences.zh: 当时没有为聋人设立的学校。

sentences.en: Deaf people often talk to each other using sign language.
sentences.zh: 聋人经常用手语互相交流。

senses.zh: 耳聋的，听不见的；不愿听的，不愿理会的
聋人（常用复数形式 the deaf）
